rules.title: Exactly one known assignment per fixture
rules.description: Every listed fixture must have exactly one assignment to a listed referee. Unknown fixture or referee IDs and duplicate assignments are violations.

rules.title: One appointment per referee
rules.description: A referee may appear at most once in the proposed matchweek, even when kickoffs do not overlap.

rules.title: Confirmed availability
rules.description: Each assigned referee must be available for that fixture. Unavailable is a violation; unknown or absent status is insufficient information. For category reporting, availability determined by committee notes belongs only to the notes category; this availability category covers structured roster status when no overriding note applies.

rules.title: No declared team conflict
rules.description: An assigned referee must have no declared conflict with either team. An empty conflicts list confirms no declared conflicts; null means the check is unknown.

rules.title: Confirmed eligibility
rules.description: An assigned referee must have eligible=true. False is a violation and null is unknown.

rules.title: Minimum calendar-day spacing
rules.description: The absolute difference between the UTC calendar date of kickoff and every listed other duty must be at least minimumGapDays. Equality is allowed. An empty otherDuties list confirms none; null means unknown.

rules.title: Evidence existed before the cutoff
rules.description: For every cited evidence record, both eventAt and knownAt must be strictly before planningCutoff. Equality is a violation. A missing cited record leaves the cutoff check unresolved. Uncited evidence is not used and does not invalidate a plan.

rules.title: Committee notes take precedence
